
[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- main.volt:2[/red bold]

GPIO 34 has no internal pull-up resistor (input-only pins 34-39).

 [dim]1 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]2 |[/dim]     pin btn: PullUpInput = 34
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Use an external pull-up resistor, or use a different pin.[/cyan]
